_comment: Node/engine/pipeline preset. Use for: @unsupervised/core, @unsupervised/engine-2d, @unsupervised/engine-3d, tooling packages, build scripts, anything that must NOT assume a DOM. (@unsupervised/schemas extends the base directly — it has no Node runtime needs.) lib is kept to ESNext only so accidental `document`/`window` usage surfaces as a type error rather than a runtime crash.
